name: smart-page-translator-extension
description: A cross-browser, cached AI page translator for Firefox and Chrome.

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:manifests && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.check:manifests: node scripts/check-manifest.mjs --target firefox && node scripts/check-manifest.mjs --target chrome
scripts.package:chrome: npm run check && node scripts/package.mjs --target chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run check && node scripts/package.mjs --target firefox
scripts.package:source: npm run check && node scripts/package.mjs --target source
